description: Solo, first shop of round 1.
Solo, three re-rolls continue the same stream.
Two players, one re-roll each.
Four players: each player has its own child stream.
Solo, the shop that ends round 1.
Three players, round 2.
Solo, round 4.
Two players, round 8.
Three players, round 12.
No earlier draws: the shop stream is the first one drawn.
The same shop label after one earlier draw gives a different stream.
Two wall shapes are already offered and a third is drawn: it is redrawn once from the weights without the other wall shapes (issue #291).
The wall-shape limit also holds in a re-roll: the fourth roll of this stream redraws a third wall shape (issue #291).
Test economy: an entry with fromRound 3 has weight 0 in round 2, so it is not offered.
Test economy: the same entry is offered from its round (round 3).
Test economy: gated in round 2 across three re-rolls (the re-rolls use the same gated weights).
Market day: 2 players, round 2 shop with one extra offer (6 offers), then two re-rolls that keep the count.
Three extra offers (8 offers): the wall-shape limit still applies to the whole set.
Solo, round 2 with nine re-rolls: the Lancer hall is on offer from round 2 (shipped list), the Tunnel, Mortar and Grand barracks are not.
Solo, round 3 with fourteen re-rolls: the Tunnel entrance (priced as an item, 10) and the Mortar join; no Grand barracks yet.
Solo, round 5 with nine re-rolls: the Grand barracks joins the shipped list.
Two players, round 8 with three re-rolls: every new building can be offered.

Test economy with a signature entry (Mana Well, Flowmancer, from round 2): only the player who has that specialist can be offered it (player 0); player 1 has another specialist and player 2 none, so their rolls have it at weight 0. Each player rolls from its own stream.
The same test economy in round 1: the signature entry's fromRound 2 still gates it for its own specialist, so the roll has no Mana Well.
Gating does not change the draws: a player of another specialist (player 1, the Alchemist) or none (player 0) rolls the same offers as with the signature entry left out of the list.

Shipped economy, round 3, with a specialist (a Beastbinder): the Familiar Roost entry (issue #475, weight 12, from round 2) is on offer, so the rolls now differ from those of shop-roll.20 (no specialist) and show Roosts.

The shipped offer list at round 2 (issue #473): the Mana Well entry (weight 12, from round 2, Flowmancer only) is on offer to the Flowmancer (player 0) and to nobody else; a player with no specialist (player 2) rolls as if it were not in the list, and the Wardsmith (player 1) rolls its own Rune Ward entry of issue #474 instead (see shop-roll.29), never the Mana Well. Nine re-rolls each.

The shipped list at round 1 for a Flowmancer (issue #473): the Mana Well is not on offer before round 2, so the roll is the roll of a player with no specialist (same seed, no specialist: the same offers). Nine re-rolls.

The shipped offer list at round 2 (issue #474): the Rune Ward entry (weight 12, from round 2, Wardsmith only) is on offer to the Wardsmith (player 0) and to nobody else; the Flowmancer (player 1) rolls its Mana Well and a player with no specialist (player 2) rolls as if neither signature entry were in the list. Nine re-rolls each.

The shipped list at round 1 for a Wardsmith (issue #474): the Rune Ward is not on offer before round 2, so the roll is the roll of a player with no specialist (same seed, no specialist: the same offers). Nine re-rolls.
